module: Flowgraph node "Activate Traffic" (once_instant). Activates traffic mode for a list of ids (vehicleIds, typically from the Spawn Vehicle Group node) via traffic:activateTraffic. Outputs: activated (pulse), vehicleIds (gameplay_traffic.getTrafficList()), total (hidden). On reset or stop: traffic:deactivateTraffic(). Legacy pin "data" renamed vehicleIds (legacyPins).

onNodeReset.desc: Deactivates traffic and resets the flags.

work.desc: Publishes the total number of AI vehicles and the activated pulse.

workOnce.desc: Activates traffic for vehicleIds (if defined) and publishes the validated traffic list.
